categories.main_business_segments: Sihuan Pharmaceutical operates primarily in three segments: medical aesthetics, innovative medicine and other medicines, and generic medicine. The medical aesthetics segment focuses on non-invasive products including botulinum toxin, hyaluronic acid, radiofrequency devices, and skin management products. The innovative medicine segment develops and commercializes innovative and biopharmaceutical drugs targeting major diseases such as diabetes, oncology, digestive diseases, and NASH. The generic medicine segment produces and markets a broad portfolio of generic drugs, mainly in cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages an independent and leading R&D technology platform with capabilities in drug development, production of various dosage forms, and medical aesthetic devices. It employs advanced biopharmaceutical technologies including biosimilars, innovative small molecule drugs, fusion proteins, and antibody-drug conjugates. The medical aesthetics segment uses biomaterial innovations such as recombinant collagen and regenerative medicine technologies. Production facilities comply with Chinese GMP standards and also consider EU and FDA standards for export readiness.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sihuan Pharmaceutical serves hospitals, medical aesthetic institutions, distributors, and end-user customers primarily in the healthcare and medical aesthetics sectors. Its products target patients with diabetes, cancer, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases, and those seeking medical aesthetic treatments. The company has established extensive nationwide marketing networks covering over 6,200 medical aesthetic institutions and more than 3,000 hospitals for pharmaceutical products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates mainly in Mainland China, which accounts for the vast majority of its revenue and assets. It also has operations and subsidiaries in the United States, Hong Kong, and other international markets. The medical aesthetics business is expanding internationally through its U.S.-based subsidiary Genesis Biosystems, targeting markets such as South Africa, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, South America, and China. The innovative drug segment pursues global clinical trials and registration, with licensing agreements covering Greater China and other regions including Europe, the U.S., Canada, Japan, South Korea, Australia, and Brazil.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sihuan Pharmaceutical operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain. It engages in R&D, manufacturing of pharmaceutical products and medical aesthetic devices, and commercialization through direct sales and distribution networks. The company also holds exclusive distribution rights for certain imported medical aesthetic products, indicating involvement in product introduction and marketing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group’s strategic focus is on innovation-driven growth with dual engines of medical aesthetics and innovative biopharmaceuticals. R&D priorities include advancing diabetes treatments (e.g., insulin biosimilars, SGLT-2 inhibitors, GLP-1 receptor agonists), oncology drugs (e.g., CDK4/6 inhibitors, ALK inhibitors), and regenerative medicine technologies. The company emphasizes international collaboration for clinical trials, pipeline optimization, and global market expansion. It also invests in upgrading medical aesthetic products and expanding brand influence domestically and internationally.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of medical aesthetics products, innovative drugs, and generic medicines. The company employs a combination of direct sales and distributor networks to reach hospitals, medical aesthetic institutions, and end customers. Licensing and exclusive distribution agreements also contribute to revenue, particularly for innovative drugs and imported medical aesthetic devices. Inclusion in national reimbursement drug lists and centralized procurement enhances product accessibility and sales volume.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sihuan Pharmaceutical positions itself as a leading medical aesthetics and innovative biopharmaceutical company in China, transitioning from a generic cardiovascular and cerebrovascular drug producer to an innovation-driven enterprise. It competes in high-growth therapeutic areas such as diabetes, oncology, and medical aesthetics. The company’s extensive product pipeline, strong R&D capabilities, and nationwide commercialization network provide competitive advantages. It collaborates with international partners and pursues global market expansion to strengthen its industry position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, the Group reported total revenue of approximately RMB1.9 billion, with medical aesthetics revenue growing 65.4% year-on-year to RMB744.2 million, innovative medicine revenue increasing 388.1% to RMB57.6 million, and generic medicine revenue declining 21.4% to RMB1.1 billion. The Group experienced an operating loss of RMB138.1 million mainly due to increased share-based payments related to its innovative subsidiaries. It maintains a strong cash position with RMB3.5 billion in cash and equivalents and a borrowings-to-equity ratio of 20.2%. The Group employs over 2,600 employees and continues to invest heavily in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sihuan Pharmaceutical emphasizes its dual-wheel strategy combining medical aesthetics and innovative biopharmaceuticals to deliver differentiated value. Its medical aesthetics products benefit from pharmaceutical-grade rigor, innovative biomaterials, and a comprehensive product portfolio covering the full lifecycle of beauty needs. In innovative drugs, the company offers a combination of first-in-class innovative drugs and first biosimilars, providing high-quality, cost-effective treatment options. Its strong R&D platform, extensive clinical pipeline, and robust commercialization capabilities differentiate it in the competitive pharmaceutical and medical aesthetics markets.
